There was some contention yesterday when playing the first scenario and using Baron Blade's teleport movement power (I do not have the card currently with me, so I don't remember the exact name or the full wording of what the card says).

Because it does state that Baron Blade can choose a spot within line of sight, if he were to stand at Elevation 4, could he teleport to any spot at elevation 3 and/or 4 using this movement ability? Obviously he can only do it one time per turn, but just looking for clarification because I do remember that it only states that LOS is required for the movement, but doesn't list the exact range.

posts.cooked: Note that it may not be every space of height 3 and 4 that he can see. If the Baron is on elevation 4, an intervening space of elevation 4 may block his Line of Sight to an elevation 3 space further on.
